name: Ichijiku Mikoto
source:
"This matter must be concluded! Let's get married!"

Hayato's classmate, a cheerful, candid, and energetic girl. Falling head over heels for Hayato due to an unexpected event. To affirm the sincerity of her feelings, she transforms into a carnivorous young lady who sweeps away rivals and forcefully pushes for her love.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294690/Yomegami_My_Sweet_Goddess/]Steam[/url]]
